description: A Perdion zealot who pays for every swing with her own blood. Anri spends Crest: Impact to convert self-inflicted damage into party-wide offence.

skills.name: Blood Chain
skills.effect: Deals [3 HIT / Total 120%] damage to all enemies in the front area. Consumes [20%] of own Max HP (cannot drop below 1 HP). Grants self a barrier worth [40%] of Max HP for [30 seconds].
skills.forceChainEffect: Self Skill DMG UP [8%] [Accumulative / Max 40%]. Consumes 5 Crest: Impact to raise the damage multiplier to [200%].

passives.name: Execution Stance
passives.effect: After 2 normal attacks, the next normal attack becomes [1 HIT / Total 150%]. Evasion Rate UP [7%] [Accumulative / Max 35%].

passives.name: Twisted Loyalty
passives.effect: On skill activation, all front allies gain CRIT Rate UP [15% / 10 seconds]. Self gains +[1] Crest: Impact.

passives.name: Rebellion
passives.effect: When Crest: Impact is consumed, all Light, Dark or Neutral allies gain Attack UP [25% / 15 seconds]. Self gains Skill Charge Efficiency UP [40% / 15 seconds] and +[1] Crest: Impact.
passives.awakenedEffect: At battle start, self gains +[8] Crest: Impact (once per quest).

facilitySkill: Serves Drinks to up to 3 random Perdion staff, raising their Satisfaction by +20%.
